texts: Um, okay, how could Motionlab be better. Let me think.
I think the first thing for me is the booking.
Like, the machines, especially the laser cutter and the big printer, they're booked out weeks in advance.
I've had a project sitting there for like three weeks because I just couldn't get a slot.
And the booking sheet is, honestly, it's kind of clunky, you have to click through three pages.
The other thing is, I can really only come on weekends because of my day job.
And on weekends the lab is either closed or there's nobody who can open the workshop.
So yeah, more weekend access would make a big difference to me.
Oh, and there's nowhere to leave my stuff.
I build these big frames, right, and I have to carry them home every single time.
A few lockers, or a shelf, you know, even just a labelled shelf, would be great.
Other than that, I love the place, to be honest.
The people are great, it's just the practical stuff.
